purpose: Synthetic calls at every native radiative X/Z grid point load the original tables into the disposable child. These calls deliberately override only opacity-library composition arguments; they are not a new stellar composition or evolution.
preserved_failure: The original stellar calls left some tables unloaded. Removing composition-coordinate rounding can require one of those neighboring tables, so missing coverage was rejected.
controls: All previously captured arrays must remain bitwise identical after cache enrichment; inspect the actual composition arguments used and preserve original binary/profile-return checks.
